originating_goal: Correct the heartbeat implementation so carrier progression is independent of workers, tasks, admissions, G18, or observation calls and is derived only from the heartbeat oscillator with a 10 ms phase-travel/reference interval.
release_condition: Independent oscillator module, v12 carrier integration, schemas/contracts, compatibility sampler, deterministic tests, and canonical handoffs are installed and source-validated; claim then releases while live observation remains separately evidenced.
collision_boundaries: Heartbeat progression must not depend on WorkerCoordinator, G18, task state, claims, fences, leases, route state, credentials, or downstream admission.
Consumers may sample/observe heartbeat references but may not cause, delay, authorize, or suppress them.
Do not mutate TV/TVC credential authority or introduce NON-TV/TVC secrets/tokens.
Do not promote GitHub, Render, Vercel, Cloudflare, or another third party to primary runtime authority.
Preserve immutable legacy HB29 provenance while correcting the separated carrier semantics.
